Figure 2:From a 3D expert to an agentic framework.(a) A 3D expert directly segments the object into parts.
(b) PartAgent integrates predictions from frozen 2D and 3D experts
and iteratively refines the segmentation through
an observation-driven loop.

Figure 3:Overview of PartAgent.(A) Structural–Semantic Expert Integration (SSEI) uses multiview
semantic evidence to refine 3D expert regions and combine them into
candidate segmentations at multiple granularities, then selects an
initial segmentation𝒫0\mathcal{P}_{0}.
(B) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement (CLR) uses a
VLM to examine the current segmentation and its supporting evidence
and choose targeted actions. Proposed segmentation updates are
verified before adoption, and feedback guides subsequent actions.

Figure 4:Observation-driven closed-loop refinement.Left: The agent inspects the rear wheel and identifies incorrect
part groupings.
Middle: It regroups existing 3D regions to separate the fender
from the tire and merge the two regions belonging to the same wheel.
Right: After the proposal passes multiview verification, the updated state and feedback guide inspection of the exhaust.

Figure 5:Progressive improvement through closed-loop refinement.Loop 0 denotes the SSEI initialization before closed-loop refinement. Loop 1 groups the cable and its connector into one part. Loop 2 merges fragments within the enclosure and within the control panel.
Loop numbers denote agent decision rounds. Insets show the same boxed regions at each loop.

Figure 6:Qualitative comparison.Comparison with SAMPart3D[46], PartField[21],
P3-SAM[23], and PartSAM[50].
On the Hunyuan3D fish, PartAgent keeps the dorsal and tail fins as one part each.
On the well, PartAgent separates the roof fittings and segments the roof surface and stone wall as one part each.
On the chest, PartAgent separates the lid from the body and keeps the handle and latch distinct.
